tasks.label: 🔍 Validate Bucket Manifests
args: Get-ChildItem -Path bucket\*.json | ForEach-Object { try { Get-Content $_.FullName | ConvertFrom-Json | Out-Null; Write-Host "[OK] $($_.Name)" -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host "[ERROR] $($_.Name): $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red } }
